parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream application. The AppName you enter must match the AppName of the live stream to be transferred for the configuration to take effect. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: DstUrl
parameters.description:
The third-party live streaming address to transfer to. A maximum of one address is supported.

>The protocol of the destination address must match the protocol of the live stream being transferred. Only RTMP and SRT protocols are supported.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time of the transfer. The date format follows ISO 8601 and uses UTC+0 time in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

>The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the transfer. The date format follows ISO 8601 and uses UTC+0 time in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: TransferArgs
parameters.description:
The transfer validity period. Valid values:

- **always**: Permanently effective.

- **time**: Effective within a specified time range.

>If you set this parameter to **time**, **StartTime** and **EndTime** are required.
